relevance_note: The paper describes four patients from two Chinese families with HA20 caused by heterozygous TNFAIP3 mutations: "WES revealed heterozygous c.559C > T in the TNFAIP3 gene in P1, P2 and P3".
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema, the rules and the instructions; no script was used, so nothing was transcribed by script and no temporary file was needed. The Markdown uses thin spaces (U+2009) in numbers with units and in variant strings; spans are copied character for character including those. Table 2 ('Clinical features of patients with TNFAIP3 mutation') has patients as rows and no reference column; Table 3 has patients as columns (Case 1 pre/post, Case 2 pre/post, Case 4 pre/post, then 'Normal range'), so each laboratory value was read in that patient's own column and compared with the printed normal range (ESR 35 and CRP 89 for Case 2, ESR 79.0 and CRP 48.0 for Case 4 are above range; haemoglobin 85.2 for Case 2 is below 110-160), which is how the elevated-CRP/ESR and anaemia rows were derived. No table cell contained values stacked with ' / ', so no stacked cells had to be left unassigned. Table 2 cells reading the word 'No' were treated as explicitly absent; the '-' in Table 2's Previous diagnosis cell for P3 was left unused because the legend defines no symbol. Contradictions found: (1) Table 2 gives P4 'Ulcers: No' while the text says she was referred 'due to oral ulcers' - both are recorded in phenotypic_features and the checklist item 'oral ulcers' is 'not reported' for P4; (2) Fig. 2 legend says 'e Contrast-enhanced MRI revealed chronic synovitis of the knee joint in P3' and 'f Lung CT scan showed interstitial lung disease (ILD) in P3', while the text attributes Fig. 2e (chronic synovitis) and Fig. 2f (ILD) to P4; the P3 synovitis and ILD rows from the legend and the P4 rows from the text are both recorded, and the checklist item 'interstitial lung disease' is 'not reported' for P3; (3) Table 2 gives P3 'Mutation origin: De novo' although the text and family 1 data say P3 carried the variant and transmitted it to P1 and P2; P3's inheritance was therefore taken from the text sentence 'Therefore, the c.559C > T and c.259C > T mutations were de novo for P3 and P4, respectively.' Ages: Table 1 prints decimals ('14.1 years'); I converted them as years and months (14.1 -> P14Y1M). Text ages differ slightly from Table 1 (P2 onset 'age 2.6' vs '2.5 years'; P4 onset 'at the age of 7 years' vs '6.9 years' and '9-year-old' vs '8.3 years'); Table 1 values were used and the differing text is visible in the spans. Absence of eye and skin findings rests on the group statements 'All patients had no signs of eye or skin problems...' and 'Four patients all had no signs of eye and skin problems...', which name the group, so those rows are 'inferred from group statement'. Relatives: the paper states the variant 'was not detected in other members in family 1' and 'was not found in her parents' without naming or separating those people, so they are kept as two rows under the paper's own wording (one per family) rather than split into invented individuals; the father of P1 and P2 is P3 and was not given a second row.
